contracts.description: Forbid recursive deletion (rm -r, Remove-Item -Recurse, rmdir /s, shutil.rmtree, find -delete). Example preset, disabled until enabled by the owner.

Forbid writes to system or home-config locations and parent-directory targets (redirects, tee, cp, mv, install, dd, sed -i, a TargetFile argument). This is a path-pattern approximation: replace it with your own workspace boundary regex. Example preset, disabled until enabled by the owner.
Forbid force pushes (--force, --force-with-lease, -f, +refspec). Example preset, disabled until enabled by the owner.
Forbid deleting local or remote branches (git branch -d/-D/--delete, git push --delete, git push origin :branch). Example preset, disabled until enabled by the owner.
